note: RECORDING EVIDENCE: Apple Music lookups were blocked or throttled for most of the run (shared fetcher; only about 20 answers got through), so MusicBrainz release titles, label pages and web searches were used instead. About 32 works rest only on IMSLP's own 'recorded' signal (their floor.recorded starts 'IMSLP links a commercial recording', confidence 'medium'): the recording itself is not identified; please verify in bulk (Saint-Saëns PQ Op. 41/Quintet Op. 14/Septet is confirmed only for the Septet; all six Goldmark works; Fauré PQ 2 and both Piano Quintets; Stanford PQ Op. 15 and PT 1-3; Chausson PQ; Lekeu PQ; Franck Op. 1 Nos. 2-3 and Op. 2; Dohnányi PQ 2; Suk Elegy; and others). Works with no signal and no recording found were skipped as 'not performed or recorded' (Stanford Piano Quintet Op. 25 and String Quintet Op. 85, Beach String Quartet Op. 89, Fibich String Quartet No. 1 and Thema con variazioni, Saint-Saëns Piano Quartet in E, Franck Grand Trio Op. 6): this is 'not found', not proof of none. DECISIONS FOR THE OWNER: (1) Smyth's Two Interlinked French Folk Melodies and Variations on Bonny Sweet Robin (flute, oboe or violin/viola, piano) and Elgar's Harmony Music Nos. 5-6 (bassoon or cello) have a string only as a printed alternative: skipped as 'no string part in the original scoring'; the census had derived a string scoring from the alternative. (2) Fauré's La bonne chanson with string quintet and piano (IMSLP section 'Voice, String Quintet and Piano Version') is not added: the liner note says the string parts 'may or may not be the work of the composer'. (3) Suk's Elegy Op. 23 is kept in its eight-player scoring (IMSLP); the discs found (Denon, Meridian, Hyperion) carry the piano-trio version, which could be a separate entry. (4) Dvořák's Andante appassionato B. 40a is added with the key F major from Wikipedia's list (the Stamitz set calls it 'Quartettsatz in A minor'). GAP CHECK ADDED (not on IMSLP): Dvořák Quartet No. 6 Op. 12, Two Waltzes Op. 54 (quartet version), Quartet Movement B. 120 and Andante appassionato B. 40a (Stamitz Quartet cycle, Brilliant Classics); Stanford String Quartets 4, 6, 7, 8 (Dante Quartet, SOMM); Chausson Chanson perpétuelle with piano and string quartet (IMSLP holds the score under the song's page). Not added for lack of a recording or performance found: Stanford Piano Quartet No. 2 Op. 133, String Quintet No. 2 Op. 86, Serenade (Nonet) Op. 95, the clarinet and horn Fantasies (not checked beyond Wikipedia's list); Beach Pastorale/Water-Sprites Op. 90 and Invocation Op. 55 (editions exist, no recording found); Saint-Saëns's Wedding Cake Op. 76 (piano and strings, string-orchestra question); Dohnányi's unpublished early quartet, piano quartet and quartet minuet; Delius's two early string quartets; Smyth's early quartets and 1880 piano trio. Smyth's String Quartet in C minor (1881) is on a commercial disc (The Maier Quartet, DB Productions 2020); her E minor quartet and the Quintet rest on IMSLP's signal. Year of Suk's Elegy left blank (not confirmed in a source opened). Durations come from IMSLP's average duration, else a recording's timing. RECHECK 2026-10-17: 15 works added (Saint-Saëns Piano Quartet in E R. 107; Franck Grand Trio CFF 108; Stanford Piano Quintet Op. 25, String Quintet No. 1 Op. 85, String Quintet No. 2 Op. 86, Piano Quartet No. 2 Op. 133, Fantasies Nos. 1-2 for clarinet and string quartet, Phantasy for horn and string quartet; Dohnányi Piano Quartet in F-sharp minor; Smyth Piano Trio in D minor; Beach String Quartet Op. 89 and Two Songs Op. 100; Fibich String Quartet No. 1 and Thema con variazioni); 3 lines settled as not performed or recorded (Saint-Saëns Barcarolle manuscript version, Smyth String Trio Op. 6, Elgar Harmony Music No. 7) and 8 lines turned into works; 0 still not checked. Of the 32 works that rested on IMSLP's 'recorded' signal, 31 now name a real recording in floor.recorded (Deezer album ids in sources, MusicBrainz release pages where Deezer lacked the disc); Suk's Elegy Op. 23 stays unconfirmed: the discs found carry only the piano-trio version (Guarneri Trio Prague, Praga Digitals; Trio 180). Not found after Deezer, Apple composerTerm and MusicBrainz lookups: Stanford Serenade (Nonet) Op. 95; Beach Op. 90 trio pieces; Dohnányi's unpublished String Quartet in D minor; Delius's early quartets; a Coleridge-Taylor D minor quartet. Hand edits to kept works: floor.recorded and sources of 32 works (the 31 above and the Dohnányi String Sextet, whose floor had cited only Wikipedia's note of a 2006 Hungaroton recording); confidence medium to high on 29 of them (Barcarolle, Romance, Serenade stay medium: scoring on the discs unverified or a printed alternative); blank minutes filled from the cited recording's timing (Barcarolle in F major, Op. 108 9; Piano Trio in B minor, Op. 1 No. 3 30; Piano Trio in B minor, Op. 2 20; Piano Trio No. 1 in B-flat m, Op. 4 29; Piano Trio No. 2 in E minor, Op. 33 29; String Quintet in A minor, Op. 9 38; Piano Quartet No. 2 in G min, Op. 45 33; Piano Quintet No. 1 in D min, Op. 89 30; Piano Trio No. 1 in E-flat m, Op. 35 32; Piano Trio in C minor, Op. 45 39; Piano Quartet in B minor 24); alternatives {piano: [harp]} added to Romance Op. 27 (the print title reads 'piano ou harpe et orgue'). DECISIONS FOR THE OWNER: (a) Beach Two Songs Op. 100 (high voice with violin, cello and piano) is added as a chamber song set because the census rule keeps voice with three instruments, but only No. 1 'A Mirage' is documented on discs; (b) the Franck Grand Trio title omits IMSLP's 'Op. 6' (kept in aka) because a Klarthe track attaches Op. 6 to the violin-and-piano Andantino CFF 115; (c) Beach's Quartet year is IMSLP's '1921-29' (Wikipedia's list says 1929). Stanford's Piano Quartet No. 2, String Quintet No. 2, the Fantasies and the horn Phantasy are not on IMSLP pages that were found (guessed titles for Op. 86 and Op. 133 are missing); the Quintet No. 2 scoring (two violins, two violas, cello) comes from MusicWeb's list of the SOMM players.
